penalties.authority: Office of Divisional Commissioner, Government of the NCT of Delhi, Revenue Department: Stamp & Registration Branch, through the Collector of Stamps
penalties.details: Proceedings were initiated by the Authority under the provisions of the Indian Stamp Act, 1899 as applicable to the National Capital Territory of Delhi for determination of stamp duty payable in relation to issuance/allotment of certain shares by the Company. In this regard, the Company received two Show Cause Notices dated February 18, 2026 and March 17, 2026 from the Authority in relation to the allotment of shares made on November 1, 2021 and August 4, 2022, respectively. The Company responded to the Show Cause Notices and, inter-alia, contended that it had duly discharged the applicable stamp duty in respect of the subject share allotments and that the proceedings initiated by the Authority under Article 19 of Schedule IA to the Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (as applicable to the NCT of Delhi) were not maintainable in view of Sections 9A(2) and 9A(3) of the Indian Stamp Act, 1899. Pursuant to the proceedings, an order dated June 15, 2026 has been passed by the Authority adjudging the Company liable to pay alleged deficit stamp duty of Rs. 1,00,25,820/- (Rupees One crore twenty-five thousand eight hundred and twenty only) along with penalty of Rs. 1,50,00,000/- (Rupees One crore fifty Lakh only). Pertinently, the Show Cause Notices issued to the Company pertain only to the allotment of shares on November 1, 2021 and August 4, 2022. However, the Order proceeds to determine and levy alleged deficit stamp duty and penalty in relation to share allotments purportedly made on August 2, 2022, January 31, 2024, March 8, 2024 and August 5, 2024. The Company is taking appropriate legal advice to defend the matter, as it believes that it has good grounds to challenge and contest the demand raised by the authorities. Accordingly, the Company is in the process of pursuing appropriate legal remedies challenging the Order.
penalties.impact: Pursuant to the proceedings, an order dated June 15, 2026 has been passed by the Authority adjudging the Company liable to pay alleged deficit stamp duty of Rs. 1,00,25,820/- (Rupees One crore twenty-five thousand eight hundred and twenty only) along with penalty of Rs. 1,50,00,000/- (Rupees One crore fifty Lakh only).

timeline.summary: Poly Medicure acquired 100% stake in Brazilian entity Medyneo through its subsidiary Polymed Brazil LIDA for R$ 180,000 on April 29, 2026.
Poly Medicure released its Monitoring Agency Report for Q4 FY26, showing ₹501.03 Cr utilized from QIP proceeds.

Poly Medicure Limited’s **Himanshu Baid (MD), Naresh Vijayvergiya (CFO), and Rahul Gautam (President-Strategy & Corporate Development)** will present Q4 & FY2026 earnings on **25 May 2026 at 5:00 PM IST** via conference call.
Poly Medicure Limited’s officials will hold one-on-one investor/meetings with analysts on May 26–29, 2026, at Company’s registered office and Faridabad plant.
Poly Medicure submitted its QIP monitoring agency report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
Poly Medicure Limited’s Avinash Chandra shared the earnings conference call recording for Q4FY26 and FY26 results via its website on May 25, 2026.
Poly Medicure reported Q4 and FY26 earnings and guided FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹2,300-2,400 Cr.

Poly Medicure Limited’s **Avinash Chandra** scheduled one-on-one analyst/investor meets on June 3–4, 2026, at Grand Hyatt Mumbai for HSBC, Quantum, Prudential ICICI, T Rowe Price, IDFC AM, Allianz Asia, and HSBC Global AM.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹525.38 Cr (+30.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹86.03 Cr (-7.6% YoY).
Poly Medicure presented Q1FY27 results showing 30.3% revenue growth and 24.1% consolidated EBITDA margin.
Poly Medicure filed QIP fund utilization statement for quarter ended Jun 2026, confirming no deviations from disclosed objects.
2026-08-10: Poly Medicure made available the audio recording of its Q1FY27 earnings conference call
Poly Medicure held its Q1FY27 conference call detailing PolyMed 3.0 vision to double revenue by FY30 and maintaining FY27 guidance.

Poly Medicure Limited’s 31st AGM on September 5, 2026, approved all resolutions via remote e-voting and in-person voting with 100% shareholder approval for financial statements and dividend declaration.
